title: Klarna Names Chris Koegel as Chief Financial Officer | Klarna International
body_markdown:
*New York, November 12, 2026:* Klarna Group plc (NYSE: KLAR), the everyday finance network, has appointed Chris Koegel as Chief Financial Officer, effective 1 January 2027, subject to regulatory approval. The appointment has been approved and endorsed by the Klarna Group plc board. He will succeed Niclas Neglén, who will remain CFO until the end of 2026.


Koegel joins from Robinhood Markets Inc. (NASDAQ: HOOD), where he is Vice President, Head of Corporate Finance and Investor Relations. He joined Robinhood in 2022 and has served on the Leadership Team through a period of significant growth; the company’s valuation has grown from less than $10bn and has exceeded $100bn during his tenure. Before Robinhood, he was Head of Investor Relations at LPL Financial LLC (NASDAQ: LPLA) from 2015 to 2022, after spending 13 years at Bain & Company. Koegel has a BA in Mathematics from Williams College, an MBA from Dartmouth College, and is based in the US in the Boston, MA area.


“Chris’s experience as a Finance leader at a US-listed consumer fintech business with a strong track record of growth and shareholder value creation will be invaluable as we enter the next phase in Klarna’s growth story,” said Sebastian Siemiatkowski, Co-Founder and CEO of Klarna.


“Klarna has built a large-scale global network that customers love. I’m excited to join Sebastian and the Klarna team as we work to deliver innovative products and value for customers, a productive and rewarding experience for employees, and long-term profitable growth for shareholders,” said Chris Koegel.
